messages.content:
You are an expert JavaScript programmer. Write a single JavaScript function that creates a comprehensive sorting algorithms visualizer.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Function takes a canvas ID parameter (canvas will be 500x500px)
- Implement 5 sorting algorithms: Bubble, Quick, Merge, Heap, Radix
- Visual bars with color coding: red (comparing), yellow (swapping), green (sorted), blue (pivot)
- Algorithm selection dropdown and speed control slider
- Toggle between step-by-step and continuous modes
- Real-time complexity analysis display (O-notation)
- Scramble button with patterns: Random, Reverse, Nearly Sorted
- Call stack depth visualization for recursive algorithms
- Real-time comparison and swap counters
- Working area highlighting for divide-and-conquer
- Smooth 60 FPS performance, no external libraries

OUTPUT: Valid JavaScript code only. No explanatory text, comments outside code, or markdown formatting.

function SortingVisualizer(canvasId){var canvas=document.getElementById(canvasId);var ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');var width=canvas.width,height=canvas.height;var N=100;var arr=new Array(N);var state=new Array(N);var comps=0,swaps=0;var algo='Bubble',speed=5,stepMode=true;var running=false,stepGen=null;var depthStack=[];var working=null;var complexityLabel={Bubble:'O(n²)',Quick:'O(n log n)',Merge:'O(n log n)',Heap:'O(n log n)',Radix:'O(nk)'};var controls=document.createElement('div');controls.style.margin='10px';document.body.appendChild(controls);var algoSelect=document.createElement('select');['Bubble','Quick','Merge','Heap','Radix'].forEach(a=>{var o=document.createElement('option');o.value=a;o.text=a;algoSelect.appendChild(o);} );controls.appendChild(algoSelect);var speedSlider=document.createElement('input');speedSlider.type='range';speedSlider.min='1';speedSlider.max='10';speedSlider.value='5';controls.appendChild(speedSlider);var stepToggle=document.createElement('input');stepToggle.type='checkbox';stepToggle.checked=true;controls.appendChild(stepToggle);var nextBtn=document.createElement('button');nextBtn.textContent='Next';nextBtn.style.display='none';controls.appendChild(nextBtn);var startBtn=document.createElement('button');startBtn.textContent='Start';controls.appendChild(startBtn);var resetBtn=document.createElement('button');resetBtn.textContent='Scramble';controls.appendChild(resetBtn);var scramSelect=document.createElement('select');['Random','Reverse','Nearly'].forEach(p=>{var o=document.createElement('option');o.value=p;o.text=p;scramSelect.appendChild(o);} );controls.appendChild(scramSelect);var stats=document.createElement('div');stats.textContent='Comparisons:0 Swaps:0 Complexity:0';controls.appendChild(stats);function reset(){comps=0;swaps=0;for(var i=0;i<N;i++){arr[i]=Math.floor(Math.random()*height);state[i]=0;}depthStack=[];working=null;}reset();function draw(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);for(var i=0;i<N;i++){var val=arr[i];var w=width/N;var h=val;var x=i*w;var y=height-h;var col='gray';switch(state[i]){case 1:col='red';break;case2:col='yellow';break;case3:col='green';break;case4:col='blue';break;}ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.fillRect(x,y,w-1,h);}if(working){var w=width/N;var col='rgba(0,255,0,0.3)';for(var i=working.l;i<=working.r;i++){ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.fillRect(i*w,0,w,height);} }if(depthStack.length){var y=0;depthStack.forEach((d,i)=>{ctx.fillStyle='black';ctx.font='10px Arial';ctx.fillText('Depth'+i,5,y+5+i*15);});}ctx.fillStyle='black';ctx.font='12px Arial';ctx.fillText('Comps:'+comps+' Swaps:'+swaps+' Complexity:'+complexityLabel[algo],10,20);}function step(){if(!running)return;var ret=stepGen.next();if(ret.done){running=false;}if(!stepMode){setTimeout(step,1000/speed);}draw();}function start(){if(running)return;reset();state.fill(0);depthStack=[];working=null;switch(algo){case'Bubble':stepGen=bubbleSort();break;case'Quick':stepGen=quickSortRec(0,N-1,0);break;case'Merge':stepGen=mergeSortRec(0,N-1,0);break;case'Heap':stepGen=heapSort();break;case'Radix':stepGen=radixSort();break;}running=true;stepMode=stepToggle.checked;if(stepMode){nextBtn.style.display='inline-block';}else{nextBtn.style.display='none';step();}}function* bubbleSort(){for(var i=0;i<N;i++){for(var j=0;j<N-i-1;j++){state[j]=1;state[j+1]=1;comps++;yield;if(arr[j]>arr[j+1]){state[j]=2;state[j+1]=2;swaps++;[arr[j],arr[j+1]]=[arr[j+1],arr[j]];yield;}state[j]=state[j+1]=0;}}for(var i=0;i<N;i++)state[i]=3;yield;}function* quickSortRec(l,r,dep){if(l>=r)return;depthStack.push(dep);var pivotIndex=r;state[pivotIndex]=4;yield;var i=l,j=r-1;while(i<=j){while(i<=j && arr[i]<=arr[pivotIndex]){i++;comps++;}while(i<=j && arr[j]>arr[pivotIndex]){j--;comps++;}if(i<j){state[i]=1;state[j]=1;comps++;yield;state[i]=2;state[j]=2;swaps++;[arr[i],arr[j]]=[arr[j],arr[i]];yield;state[i]=state[j]=0;i++;j--;}}if(i<r){[arr[i],arr[r]]=[arr[r],arr[i]];swaps++;state[i]=2;state[r]=2;yield;state[i]=state[r]=0;}state[pivotIndex]=0;yield;yield* quickSortRec(l,i-1,dep+1);yield* quickSortRec(i+1,r,dep+1);depthStack.pop();}function* mergeSortRec(l,r,dep){if(l>=r)return;var m=Math.floor((l+r)/2);working={l:l,r:r};yield;yield* mergeSortRec(l,m,dep+1);yield* mergeSortRec(m+1,r,dep+1);var temp=[];var i=l,j=m+1;while(i<=m&&j<=r){comps++;state[i]=1;state[j]=1;yield;if(arr[i]<=arr[j]){temp.push(arr[i]);i++;}else{temp.push(arr[j]);j++;}}while(i<=m){temp.push(arr[i]);i++;}while(j<=r){temp.push(arr[j]);j++;}for(var k=0;k<temp.length;k++){state[l+k]=2;swaps++;arr[l+k]=temp[k];yield;state[l+k]=0;}working=null;for(var t=l;t<=r;t++)state[t]=3;yield;}}function* heapSort(){for(var i=Math.floor(N/2)-1;i>=0;i--)heapify(i,N);for(var i=N-1;i>0;i--){state[0]=2;state[i]=2;swaps++;[arr[0],arr[i]]=[arr[i],arr[0]];yield;state[0]=state[i]=0;heapify(0,i);}}function heapify(i,n){var max=i;var l=2*i+1,r=2*i+2;if(l<n&&arr[l]>arr[max])max=l;if(r<n&&arr[r]>arr[max])max=r;if(max!=i){state[i]=2;state[max]=2;swaps++;[arr[i],arr[max]]=[arr[max],arr[i]];yield;state[i]=state[max]=0;heapify(max,n);} }function* radixSort(){for(var base=1;base<Math.max(...arr);base*=10){var output=new Array(N);var count=new Array(10).fill(0);for(var i=0;i<N;i++){var digit=Math.floor((arr[i]/base)%10);count[digit]++;state[i]=1;comps++;yield}for(var i=1;i<10;i++)count[i]+=count[i-1];for(var i=N-1;i>=0;i--){var digit=Math.floor((arr[i]/base)%10);output[--count[digit]]=arr[i];state[i]=2;swaps++;yield}for(var i=0;i<N;i++){arr[i]=output[i];state[i]=0;}}}startBtn.onclick=start;stepToggle.onchange=function(){stepMode=stepToggle.checked;if(stepMode)nextBtn.style.display='inline-block';else nextBtn.style.display='none';};nextBtn.onclick=step;scramSelect.onchange=function(){switch(scramSelect.value){case'Random':for(var i=0;i<N;i++)arr[i]=Math.floor(Math.random()*height);break;case'Reverse':for(var i=0;i<N;i++)arr[i]=height-i;break;case'Nearly':for(var i=0;i<N;i++)arr[i]=i<N/2?i+Math.round(Math.random()*2):N-1-i+Math.round(Math.random()*2);break;}};resetBtn.onclick=reset;algoSelect.onchange=function(){algo=algoSelect.value;stats.textContent='Comparisons:0 Swaps:0 Complexity:'+complexityLabel[algo];};speedSlider.oninput=function(){speed=parseInt(speedSlider.value);};setInterval(draw,16);}
